avis.titre: I have been buying this product for years
avis.texte: I'm 63 years old and because I have been using the eye serum once a week for years under my eyes and on my temple areas I have no wrinkles or under eye bags.
Left my skin really soft and smooth! Great to add after cleanser and ive been layering it with a moisturizing cream after for winter.
If I'm just wearing sunscreen, I like to apply this moisturizer prior to the sunscreen to hydrate my skin.
my all time favorite skincare product and ive tried A LOT. i 100% recommend.

avis.titre: The on-sale price is still more than everyone else's price.
avis.texte: Love the product but it is much more expensive at Ulta than anywhere else by about 50 percent.
I love the texture, the packaging, the price point and most importantly the way it hydrates my skin. This is a must have in my daily routine.

All I gotta say is wow!! This product has helped my skin so much. I would experience really bad dry patchy areas on my face as well as acne and omg it has hydrated my face so much especially living in New Mexico where it is dry. You will not regret this product it is amazing and now it's my to go too everyday uses in the morning and nighttime, my face has cleared up so much and looks healthier then ever.

I'm a fan of the Hydro Boost Face Cleanser so figured I'd like this as I thought there was nothing wrong with a little extra boost of hydration. My skin is somewhat oily and sometimes dry, but most products I use keep it nice and smooth. I used this for about two weeks and I began to notice that my skin was starting to get flaky and really dry. Hadn't changed anything about my routine other than adding in this serum so I stopped using it and things went back to normal, luckily. Not using this again. The only good thing I can say is that the serum itself did sink into the skin pretty fast so you didn't get stuck with lingering residue.

Although it's supposed to hydrate, this product dries out my skin. It may work for some, but not for me. I have somewhat oily t-zone but this product dries out my skin. This is my second time trying it and it did the same thing both times.
I love the whole hydro boost line but this is one of my favorites. It's lightweight, absorbs well, and a light pleasant scent. I use it morning and night.
Love the smell of this. I use this before the Hydroboost Gel Cream and my skin loves it. I've noticed a difference in my skin and it really prepares for makeup as well. Love this!!!

I was hesitant about buying this product because nothing has worked for the one dry patch I have on my cheek. After 3 days of using this I could notice such a BIG difference. This is now my holy grail product. My sensitive skin has not suffered from it. I like to apply it while my face is still a bit damp. Once it's dry I apply my moisturizer.

I am 52 and have always had normal to oily skin, but this past year it has been needing a bit more hydration. I can't go with a creamier moisturizer because my skin will break out. This serum has been the perfect solution! It makes a huge difference in the hydration of my skin but never feels greasy. It goes right into my skin. The scent reminds me of the ocean but isn't overpowering. Younger ladies: Always pump your serum onto the back of your hand before applying to your face and then rub the tops of your hands together. Your hands are one of the first places to show signs of aging. Nobody believes I am 52 because my hands look so young!

avis.titre: I would but this product again
avis.texte: I use the whole line of hydro boost products and i love the way my skin feels after using. The products are so gentle on my skin.
I love all Neutrogena products. I use this before using the Neutrogena gel moisturizer and my skin feels so hydrated!

This serum has me in disbelief. It has helped me rid of my usual dry spots on my chin and around my mouth. It even works with my oily skin, by not making it any oilier. I'm so happy I found this product and I will for sure keep buying, just wish they made it in a bigger size, but two pumps does it for me.

I have used many serums, but this one is in my top 2. It is light weight, hydrating smells great and makes my skin look plump. I only stay away from this product, because it can be expensive when you use it twice a day.

avis.titre: I will continue to use this product!
avis.texte: I use morning and night before moisturizer. I felt a big difference. Better than a hyaluronic moisturizer for me those creams aren't rich enough.

I have been comptemplating tying this for a while and finally took the jump. This is just what my skin needed. My skin feels hydrated soft and silky. Not sure if it will work the same once it gets hotter out. Y'all know how that is.

I picked this up shortly before I traveled abroad in 2017-- it was my favorite product and the only one I used daily during my travels aside from dry shampoo! It has a subtle smell, it's light, cold the skin, and moisturizes. Fast forward to today and I still use it (at night). My face looks awake and supple every morning!
Use it on the morning. Smells so good! Feels good on my face
This serum seriously is better than a lot of the more expensive serums I have. Leaves skin so soft and moisturized.

I got Covid a couple months ago, which turned into pneumonia and I ended up in the hospital for a bit. It really messed my skin up, my face was so dry and I was having to moisturize 5-6x a day. I decided to give this a go a week ago, and holy moly this stuff has turned my skin around! I would highly recommend this to anyone!
If you're looking for a simple serum, I recommend this. Not as hydrating another serum I own, though.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I loved this serum I noticed a difference on my skin the first time I used it !
so far, it works well but it leaves a little sticky texture after.

I have excessively dry skin I'm always trying out new serums and moisturizers from the expensive to high brand ones, and let me tell you this is literally my go to after I get out the shower or wash my face I out some on my face and when I wake up I swear it's smooth and soooooooo HYDRATING you cannot beat the price I bought this a while back and emptied out the bottle I literally just stock up on these
I use this after I tone my face with witch hazel and let it set for like 2 mins before exfoliating

avis.titre: Really like how hydrating this is
avis.texte: I have started using this product daily and really like how hydrating it is.
This is just the most recent of several Neutrogena products that have left my face feeling burned and irritated. I'm done with the brand

avis.titre: I have used this product again and again!
avis.texte: I am over 60 and this product has made my face hydrated and soft. I keep replenishing my supply!

The fragrance in this product and the hydroboost gel moisturizer make my skin break! I gave this a break and came back to it to verify and it's only gave me problems. I'll stick to the Ordinary for serum.

I have an oily t zone buy very dry cheeks so I needed a little something more to add with my daily lotion. This stuff was just what I was looking for. Not crazy expensive, especially since this brand goes on sale alot. Already bought 2 back ups.

avis.titre: Better product for the Hydroboost line
avis.texte: I do not think this product was very effective but it did have a nice fragrance and was lightweight which was good for the Texas summer heat. However, I did not see an improvement in my skin. Perhaps I should have used it longer to see the full effects. (used it for 2 months and gave the rest to my BF to use on his dry face)

avis.titre: Love the formula, hate the fragrance.
avis.texte: I really liked what this product did for my skin but I couldn't stand the strong fragrance.

I have very dry and sensitive skin....Why did you all have to add fragrance in what would be a perfect product? I used it and I love the texture and feel of it. It's non-greasy and it would be perfect. The fragrance stings around the eyes. I'll use up what I have but won't repurchase.

I used this twice, alone, and it provided a nice, light moisturized but not greasy feeling. The scent gradually dissipated, so I would test it before purchasing if you are sensitive to smells. After the two days, I noticed bumps appearing on my upper cheeks. I had worn no other product and it was the only change in my routine. I'll just go back to using aloe gel and my regular Neutrogena for combination skin.

avis.titre: love, love this brand and its overall products!
avis.texte: I use the makeup remover for hydrating skin, then use they hydroboost hydrating serum in the morning and at night before going to bed, Along with the whipped body lotion.
This is my go to from this line. Just love the extra boost of moisturizing it gives me under my daily moisturizer. Can always feel a difference when I go back to it after a while of not using.
This is the best serum on the market for the prince! Makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated!
My skin has been very dry lately and ever since adding the serum into my skincare routine my skin feels hydrated. It sinks into the skin quickly, doesn't leave my skin irritated or over dried.

This serum is amazing! I've only been using it for a few days and am already seeing results. My skin is noticeably softer and smoother, and it makes my makeup go on so nicely. This is now a must-have in my routine.
My face has been dryer lately and since I've started using this it's so much more moisturized.
I use this before my primer. Most all moisturizers sit on top of skin. This is full of moisture and soaks in instead of leaving the feeling of just sitting on top .

i just purchased my 5th bottle and i can't live without it. perfect base before moisturizer!!! when i traveled to Asia, i only used this serum + face oil moisturizer and that was all i needed throughout my trip!

Use this combined with the watergel twice daily. Once in the morning before makeup application and then after cleansing at night. Skin has never felt so silky smooth and hydrated. Makeup goes on better and skin doesn't get oily throughout the day. Love the lightweight feel, and love the affordability.
I picked this one up by mistake. I use the No 9 line, but I like this. It's not as moisturizing as the Neutrogena No 9, but this one is fine.
The serum does a good job at hydrating my skin but that is only after the slight burning sensation goes away. After a few minutes it starts to dry and ball up on my skin.

avis.titre: Fragrance is terrible for your skin!
avis.texte: I received this serum as a Christmas gift and I like it, it is hydrating however there is a lot of fragrance in the serum and if you didn't know, fragrance can cause allergies, irritation, and damage to your skin barrier. Remove the fragrance and this would be a great product.

I LOVE this product! I use it twice a day in the AM and PM after I wash my face. It glides on and it's gentle on my face. It doesn't irritate my skin like some other products do. I have seen an improvement in the texture of my skin

avis.titre: One of the best serums on the market
avis.texte: I've purchased a lot of serums in the last 10 years. This is by far my favorite hydrating one. After a week I noticed my skin was firmer, plumper and hydrated. I highly recommend this product

avis.titre: Oh yes!  Ladies, over 50 buy this!
avis.texte: Put on after you do a sugar scrub *The coffee one from loreal is spot on* and then put the serum, then buy the moisturizer. your skin will be smooth and amazing... glows!
I use this after micro needling. I think it smooths my skin.
I love this serum it is very hydrating and has helped with my texture.
This is my favorite hydrating serum. Using it before my moisturizer is a must for me.
I was just looking for a simple moisturizer for daily use and I had no skin problem until I started using this. My facial skin got really dried out!!!
this has helped my skin so much, i have combo skin and have issues with my foundation cracked on the sides if my nose. will definitely become a product to my skin regimen.

This serum is great after you wash your face and put a face moisturizer afterward. It soothes my dry patches, especially under my chin. I even have seen a huge difference this winter, usually, my skin is dry skin is flaky. But using this bad boy has helped me a lot. I still have some dry skin but at least is not flaky.
Just started using it and can see a difference in my skin, lines are not as deep. I like this product because it is pure, no other additives..great reaccommendation from your staff.

This is the very first serum I ever used and I don't think I'll ever try another! I have noticed my face has been much softer, more plump and bright since using this. It has been my absolute favorite part of my skin routine. It also smells amazing!
I love that the Hydroboost is very light, not oily but does the job like the expensive brands.
I love this stuff. It's super hydrating just like it claims to be. My skin felt amazing after just one use.

I am an African American women with combo skin. It's in the middle of winter and I've heard great things about this serum along with the moisturizer so I gave it a try. At first I used the moisturizer by itself before adding the serum with it. That was a mistake. Each night I used this, I noticed my cheeks started to get dry but I thought it was because of the sudden climate changes and the cold weather. But I was wrong. I tried it for four days straight and each time this serum made my skin more and more dry on my cheeks. It was to the point where it was peeling and looked like I ate powdered sugar and dead skin was in little tiny patches. Kind of like creped skin. As it turns out this serum has benzyl alcohol in it, which is pretty bad. My skin basically malfunctioned and as soon as I exfoliated the dead skin off that accumulated because of the serum and used another hydrating serum (by Botanics) my skin felt 1000% better. I will be throwing this away (if I don't find the receipt). I would never recommend this specific product to anyone. The moisturizer I'll be keeping though.

First time to purchase & will continue to keep in my skin care routine. I'm using as recommended between cleansing and moisturizing at night, so far I have been able to cut back on day time moisturizing. It feels wonderful, going on smoothly. A little goes a long way. Also, no breakouts (I have scars and very sensitive but dry skin).

avis.titre: Love it really helps add softness moisture to skin
avis.texte: It slips on let soak in for maybe 2 minutes then I apply moisturizer. If your dry skinned this is a must to help pull moisture from the air into your skin.

I have very dry sensitive skin and I've tried several creams and serums, but this one works the best for me. My skin has become extremely soft and my pores look smaller all day. There's no weird smell and it absorbs quickly.
Worked great for my skin. The area around my eyebrows stay dry and this product keeps the dry skin away. However the product doesn't last long for me.
Started using neutrogena hydrating serum in October and it has been great...my skin is more soft and smooth and definitely hydrated. Try it, you will love love love..
This is wonderful hydration for skin. It's not greasy or oily. Love the results.
Use before any Neutrogena moisturizer. I let it soak in for a couple minutes.It works fast.

I've been using the Hydro Boost line for a few years now, and absolutely love it. Previously I was a department store brand buyer, but this Neutrogena line is fabulous. Without a doubt, my skin is smoother and more supple after each use. My routine is at night I cleanse (and exfoliate a few times per week), then apply the Hydro Boost serum, wait a bit then apply the Hydro Boost Booster, then right before bed I apply the Hydro Boost water gel.....I can literally feel how supple my skin is the next morning. I also use the Hyrpdro Boost eye gel, which is great. I occasionally rotate in other treatments and products, but this line is a keeper and I always come back to it. I'm 49 and literally have no wrinkles.
I use very high end skin care but this is my holy grail daytime serum. It hydrates and softens my skin for an all day glow.

I use this every night before my night cream and it really helps my skin recover from the day. I have stopped using it before and my skin just isn't as light and balanced as it is when I use this. This is my second bottle already

I first tried the Hydroboost Hydrating Serum when the weather was cold and dry. It kept my face hydrated without an oily feel. It didn't irritate my skin or cause me to breakout like other creams I have tried. It became part of my routine and I have been using it during summer. The bottle finally ran out and had to get another. I would give it 5 stars if it were fragrance free. At first the smell was strong but it doesn't linger.
This is a great product that gives and helps you retain moisture without feeling heavy.
So far I like this product the constituency feels great, its a guy buy for the price.

I really liked this product. It feel super lightweight and sinks into the skin nicely. The scent is very fresh and clean, but not to strong (which I really like). It left my moderately dry skin feeling soft and dewy. I also find the price very reasonable. I can definitely picture myself buying this product again.
I use this right after my toner and right before my moisturizer and my skin feels smooth, and supple all day/night!

avis.titre: The question is, what would you buy again? YES
avis.texte: I use it before applying makeup. The serum is absorbed instantly, fully hydrated and bright day after day. Without oil (does not clog the pores)

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I use this product during the day for my face, and put it on before my moisturizer. My skin loves it and it feels so hydrated throughout the day. It is super light, and does not feel like you really have anything on your face. My skin has felt healthier and smoother since I have been using this.
Helps make your dry face feel normal. Hydrating is the correct word. Best product I hav ever used on my dry face. Feels like silk while putting it on and continues to hydrate all day.
The best product to hydrate skin. I started to get dry patches on my face now that it's hot and this has taken them away. My makeup looks a lot better now. Will buy again!

I have sensitive combo skin and I always like to use this serum after cleansing and before my SPF daily moisturizer for the day and before I apply my night cream. It makes me skin feel supple and I feel works great under makeup. I usually pair it with a face mist for extra hydration. Love this product and would definitely buy it again!

I'm not a review writer but this stuff has impressed me. I bought this as an effort to provide a boost to my skin as it recovers from a benzoyl peroxide burn/rash. This serum did more to help that heal in one night than just healing cream and moisturizer did in several days. The rest of my skin looks so much better too though. I hadn't even realized how much better my skin could look. I honestly didn't have huge expectations from this product. I was just hoping it would help the rash heal a little faster. I'll definitely be continuing use of this product after seeing the results.

This product is amazing. It is so smooth and moisturizing but very light weight. I have dry skin but I sweat a lot. I wanted a production that would moisturize my skin but not feel heavy. I also wanted something that would burn my eyes if I sweat (I've had this problem with other moisturizers and lotions). This is perfect. I was so shocked by how supple and smooth and moisturized my skin felt after even one application!!! This is a price-y product for me and I am pretty low maintenance beauty wise but I will buy this again and again. It comes in a pump bottle and has a more liquid texture (as opposed to the thicker Hydro Boost Gel-Cream which I also purchase). Glides on so smooth. I feel indulgent and like I am really taking care of my skin when I use both. But both products are great alone as well. You can even use as an overnight treatment and then apply again when your day starts in the morning. I love this Hydro Boost line!!!! I even want the eye cream now. This just soaks into your skin and feels rich but light. I know you're not supposed to let others touch your face but I was so impressed by how soft my skin was after I was begging friends and family to touch! Ha! There is not really a smell to this product either so great for those with fragrance sensitivity.

I have found the perfect moisturizer for my face/skin. I have sensitive skin that is easily irritated. Most moisturizers are heavy and irritate my skin. This one however, is light, absorbs well, and feels great

I use this product after washing my face and before my moisturizer. I do think it has helped my skin stay hydrated. I only wish there was more information about the differences of each product in the hydroboost line and what they are good for. When shopping they all seemed to have the same general helps and don't specify which products to buy and use together so it was a little confusing. But overall I think this has helped with hydration.

Absorbs like a dream on my combination skin. I usually use straight rosehip oil as a moisturizer, but in the summer when it gets humid I like to limit that just to the flaky areas, and supplement with this (although I will probably continue using it through the winter). The moisture keeps my skin supple all day, it doesn't break me out, and it's much more effective than the hydrating Caudalie serum that costs quadruple. Win, win, win!
this works great for me. gentle, light, and not sticky at all. have and will repurchase.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This is amazing I have dry skin and this gives me a good amount of hydration without it feeling to heavy. I highly recommend.

I've been using this for a few days and already I can tell it's a 100% worth it. My dehydrated oily skin feels so much better and it's not weighed down by creams and/or heavy moisturizers. The perfect product for oily but dehydrated skin!!

This had been in my skincare routine for a week and a half, it has performed heavenly. I have very dry, I usually still have dry patches in the summer dry, and very sensitive acne prone skin. This has not made me break out which is already more than I can say for a lot of serums I've used. As well as this has been helping my dry patches more than any other serum I've tried. I pair it with the neutrogena hydro boost water gel moisturizer and my skin looks so hydrated and healthy afterwards. It helps me completely rid of my dry patches!! The only time I notice my dry patches reappearing is if I wear rather drying makeup products which I've been trying to use up. But on days when I wear the right makeup or none at all my dry patches stay gone all day long.

Recently, I started using a matte foundation which left my skin very dry. Therefore, I have been shopping around for a lightweight face moisturizer Which would not make my foundation transfer due to sweating when it is very hot. I forgot that in the past all of the Neutrogena products have never failed me. Therefore, when I saw this product at Ulta Beauty, I tried it. I had excellent results, was extremely happy and Hydro boost is was just what I was looking for. It is lightweight moisturizer which leaves my skin silky soft. I will continue using it. If you are searching for a moisturizer like this, I highly recommend it.
Never did I have sensitive skin after 2 weeks one day It just left my face red and bumpy

I have extremely dry, sensitive, acne prone skin so finding products that don't trigger a break out but hydrate my skin well is difficult. This product is AMAZING. I absolutely love it, no break outs and my dry skin is fully hydrated and feels so smooth and soft all day long. Use it both morning and evening beneath my regular moisturizers.
I love the feel of this product when it is applied. It was recommended by my dermatologist who said she uses it also!
Been struggling with extremely dry skin from the cold weather, but this stuff was my saving grace!

I love the eye gel in this line so I thought I'd give this serum a try but it did not work with my skin type. It seemed to sink in to the skin quickly but would leave it feeling tacky. Eventhough it is tacky, it doesn't pill on the skin; that was one major concern I had when I first used this. I've only been able to use this at night and have to thorughly wash my face in the morning, otherwise I turn into a grease ball.
This is my first serum that I have used on a consistent basis. I like it a lot.

I love this serum. I got 2 bottles when they were having a sale and im so glad i did. I use 2 pumps after washing my face in the morning and my skin just drinks it up. Also i have oily acne prone skin but this doesnt leave me oily or made me break out. Its a great prep step before putting on my foundation, makes it look so smooth and flawless. I will definitley repurchase after i finish both bottles.

I love this stuff. It's absolutely amazing. I have dry skin plus eczema. I bought this because I was looking for extra hydration since this winter weather is destroying me. I was going into this purchase a skeptic and I'm a complete believer. I use this day and night under my moisturizer and I noticed an immediate change after one use. I no longer wake up with dry patches and flaky skin on my face. My face feels amazing and I am thoroughly pleased. I will definitely repurchase this again
Love this! ❤️❤️ I use it before I put on my makeup. Very moisturizing and soothing. It has an amazing fresh scent. I am sensitive to strong fragrance and this is perfect. Holy Grail status for me.

I am 25, fair skinned, burn easily, tan terribly, normal to dry skin, and have aging concerns (due to being pale and on the dry side). I have adopted the Hydro Boost skin care line to replace my CeraVe routine. After using the cleanser at night, I follow up with this serum mixed with a dab of the water gel. It feels lovely and leaves my skin feeling fresh, soft, smooth and possibly helps (in combination with the rest of the line) to reduce the redness in my cheeks.

I HATE moisturizers in general, i dont love feeling things on my skin. My skin is very sensative and combo to oily. Im super busy but have learned to make time for a very small easy skin care routine. This feels lighter than the gel clinique moisturizer. Not sure if it works better but it does feel better.
Okay so I really like this producy it's very nice and affordable but my only thing is that it has a smell not a bad one but just a tad too stron for me besides that it's great!
This is a great hyrdrating serum. Smells nice and fresh. It's thin, moisturizes great, and is easily layered over. Winner.

I have used this for about 1.5 - 2 weeks now and it seems to be working fine. I tend to be oily but the skin on my nose still tends to slake off and makeup will look patchy. This product fixes that! Only reason I haven't given it 5 stars is because every time I use it, my acne spots become very red but I am not sure if the product causes this or if it is just from me rubbing the product on my face. Either way it goes away eventually.
